data.name: Forever World Cup Simulator
data.detailed_description:
Major Updates

1. Since the latest updates in June 2025, you can create your own competitions.

2. You no longer need to launch the Steam version to register for the premium access to the v1 website. You can now sign in directly through Steam on the site. Once your buyer status is verified, you’ll gain access to the site's premium features.


Accessing web content

Steam owner can sign in via Steam and unlock premium features on the version 1 site (Check the "Visit the website" link) as a bonus.

While there is no plan to change in the near future, the publisher reserves the right to change, modify, or discontinue premium access to the web version at any time, with or without prior notice. Any changes will be effective immediately upon posting on the website. Your continued use of web access after any modifications constitutes your acceptance of the new terms. We recommend that you regularly review the premium access terms to stay informed of any updates.


About the Game

Forever World Cup Simulator lets you simulate over 50 football leagues and tournaments. The simulator features dynamic team evolution and extensive customization options. 

Features

  • Over 50 international football leagues and tournaments to simulate, including the 48-team World Cup, 64-team World Cup, EURO Cup, UEFA / Americas Nations League, AFC Cup, AFCON,

  • Unique competitions like Commonwealth Games, League of the Three Kingdoms, Cold War Knockout, 512-team knockout, American Civil War II Soccer League.

  • Create your own competition with ease using the built-in editor.

  • Import historical team attributes and ratings from any dates between the 1870s and 2020s.

  • Each team has a different development path in every save, which makes long-term simulation more interesting.

  • Over 500+ downloadable teams.

  • About 300 teams available by default, including FIFA affiliated and non affiliated national teams, vintage teams and 51 American state teams.

  • Some teams' flags, name, squad photos etc will be changed accordingly when you change the starting year of the first tournament and these identities are customizable.

  • Powerful editor to create unlimited number of new teams or update existing teams' attributes, flags and various images. 

  • Quick matches section to simulate hundreds of matches that took place in the past, including Friendlies and major tournaments like AFCON, AFC Asia Cup.

  • Complete an entire year with up to 10+ competitions in less than 5 minutes! You can easily simulate far into 2100 in less than 2 hours.

  • Ability to enter match scorelines manually.

  • Real life past encounter statistics between international teams. 

  • Analyze each team's performance with detailed statistics and interactive charts.

  • Head-to-Head section: Pick any two teams and pit them against each other. Track their rivalry with a standing table to record results and standings.

  • Edit and track referee performance with a referee editor and statistics. Watch referees grow or decline in reputation over time.

  • Innovative "Road to 270" section, inspired by the United States' electoral map.

  • Random incidents that can affect teams' performances.

  • Lots of UI or game engine settings, including match incident frequency, make sim button drag-gable, dark/light mode,

  • Jersey editor to customize all football teams' jerseys. These jerseys will be featured in championship matches.

  • With Steam Cloud support, you can export your saved game data to a specific folder, and Steam will then synchronize that data across multiple platforms. It works with the web and Steam version.

data.short_description: The World Cup finals are here—are you ready to win it all? Lead 220+ dynamically evolving national teams to glory in this deep soccer simulation. Simulate 40+ global events, from continental cups to the grand stage. Perfect for fans of international football management and endless replayability!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win10/Win11
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 or AMD Athlon 64 X2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Internet connection required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: OS X 10.15
  • Processor: Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20 or later, Arch linux 2023 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 or AMD Athlon 64 X2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended that you enable Proton
